分析流程与参数

从专题 README 抽取；原文顺序保留，未跑过的部分照实标注。

定位：画图工具的入口层。每个子目录 = 一个可调用的可视化服务（MCP server、在线绘图站、模板库），记录它的安装方式、调用方式、实际能力与踩坑。

与上级目录的分工：02_可视化/01_小提琴图 … 13_雷达图 是自己复现过的成品图；本目录是检索和起步的工具。先用这里找到「画什么、用什么画、代码长什么样」，再落到自己目录里改写。

注意

  • 收录的第三方服务多是 CC-BY-NC(-SA) 类非商用许可，投稿前确认口径：Bizard CC-BY-NC-4.0，FigureYa CC BY-NC-SA 4.0。
  • 走 MCP 的服务注册在 ~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml，工具名形如 mcp__&lt;serverName>__&lt;tool>。改配置后如未生效，重启 dsh web。
  • 本目录只存笔记与脚本，不存模型权重、不存大数据集。
展开其余 4 个章节（工具栈、数据格式、可视化方法、参考文献等）

目录约定

新增工具时按 0X_工具名/ 建目录，编号递增，内部保持同一套文件语义：

0X_工具名/
├── README.md            # 必填：是什么、怎么装、怎么用、实测数据、踩坑
├── 01_install.sh        # 选填：一键安装 + 注册（须幂等，支持 --check）
├── 02_xxx_client.py     # 选填：脱机命令行客户端（尽量只用标准库）
└── xxx_index.csv        # 选填：本地索引快照，便于 grep / 离线查

README 建议覆盖这几节，方便日后自己回头看：

  1. 一句话 —— 这东西解决什么问题
  2. 安装状态 —— 装在哪些 agent 里，复核命令是什么
  3. 文件表 —— 每个文件干什么
  4. 常用命令 —— 直接可复制
  5. 实测数据 —— 规模、分类、版本号、生成日期
  6. 踩坑记录 —— 编号列，写清现象和原因

怎么挑工具

需求 去哪
不知道这图该叫什么 / 哪个包画 Bizard bizard_search（中文也能搜）
要一份能直接跑的基线代码 Bizard bizard_get_code（单个图表片段）
要完整可改的 .Rmd 模板（含数据准备+依赖安装） FigureYa figureya_search → figureya_get_code
想按包名反查哪些图用了它（如「所有用 ComplexHeatmap 的模板」） FigureYa figureya_search("ComplexHeatmap")
要按自己的数据结构改 Bizard bizard_adapt_guidance / FigureYa figureya_adapt_guidance
成图要引用出处 Bizard bizard_cite / FigureYa figureya_cite（DOI 10.1002/imm3.70005）
想要交互式 / 网页版模板 待收录（ImageGP、Hiplot 独立站等）

典型链路：Bizard 查图名 → FigureYa 找同场景完整模板并取码 → 按 adapt 清单改 → 记坑。

01_bizard-mcp/01_install.sh bash · 4321 bytes 
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# ============================================================
# Bizard MCP 一键安装 / 注册脚本（幂等，可重复跑）
#
# 做的事：
#   1. npm 全局安装 @openbiox/bizard-mcp（已装则跳过，有新版则升级）
#   2. 注册进 DSH web profile（~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml）
#   3. 注册进 Codex CLI（~/.codex/config.toml）
#   4. 冒烟测试：起 stdio 进程跑一次 tools/list
#
# 用法:
#   ./01_install.sh            # 安装 + 注册全部
#   ./01_install.sh --dsh      # 只注册 DSH
#   ./01_install.sh --codex    # 只注册 Codex
#   ./01_install.sh --check    # 只做体检，不安装不写入
# ============================================================
set -euo pipefail

PKG="@openbiox/bizard-mcp"
DSH_PATCH="$HOME/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml"
CODEX_CFG="$HOME/.codex/config.toml"

ONLY_DSH=0; ONLY_CODEX=0; CHECK_ONLY=0
for a in "$@"; do
  case "$a" in
    --dsh)   ONLY_DSH=1 ;;
    --codex) ONLY_CODEX=1 ;;
    --check) CHECK_ONLY=1 ;;
    *) echo "未知参数: $a"; exit 1 ;;
  esac
done

say() { printf '\n=== %s ===\n' "$1"; }

# ---------- 1. 安装 ----------
if [ "$CHECK_ONLY" -eq 1 ]; then
  say "体检"
  command -v bizard-mcp >/dev/null && echo "✅ 可执行: $(command -v bizard-mcp)" || echo "❌ 未安装 bizard-mcp"
  grep -q "mcp-bizard" "$DSH_PATCH" 2>/dev/null && echo "✅ DSH 已注册" || echo "❌ DSH 未注册"
  grep -q "mcp_servers.bizard" "$CODEX_CFG" 2>/dev/null && echo "✅ Codex 已注册" || echo "❌ Codex 未注册"
  exit 0
fi

say "1/4 安装 $PKG"
if npm ls -g --depth=0 2>/dev/null | grep -q "@openbiox/bizard-mcp"; then
  echo "已安装，跳过（升级请手动：npm update -g $PKG 或 npm i -g $PKG@latest）"
else
  npm install -g "$PKG"
fi
BIN="$(command -v bizard-mcp || true)"
[ -n "$BIN" ] || { echo "❌ 安装后找不到 bizard-mcp，检查 npm prefix 是否在 PATH"; exit 1; }
echo "可执行路径: $BIN"
# 用 bin 软链而不是 readlink 到 dist/index.js：后者是包内实现细节，升级换布局就失效。
# 注意：$BIN 位于 nvm 版本目录（.../versions/node/vX/bin/），切换 node 大版本后需重跑本脚本。
BIN_REAL="$BIN"

# ---------- 2. 注册 DSH ----------
if [ "$ONLY_CODEX" -eq 0 ]; then
  say "2/4 注册 DSH"
  if [ ! -f "$DSH_PATCH" ]; then
    echo "⚠️  找不到 $DSH_PATCH，跳过（非 web profile 用户请手动加）"
  elif grep -q "mcp-bizard" "$DSH_PATCH"; then
    echo "已存在 mcp-bizard 配置，跳过（如需改路径请手动编辑）"
  else
    cp -a "$DSH_PATCH" "$DSH_PATCH.bak-$(date +%Y%m%d%H%M%S)"
    python3 - "$DSH_PATCH" "$BIN_REAL" <<'PY'
import sys, pathlib
patch, binpath = pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]), sys.argv[2]
s = patch.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
block = f"""
    - id: mcp-bizard
      name: "@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client"
      config:
        serverName: bizard
        transport: stdio
        command: {binpath}
        args: []
"""
anchor = "    - id: mcp-tavily\n"
if anchor not in s:
    sys.exit("未找到插入锚点 mcp-tavily，请手动添加")
patch.write_text(s.replace(anchor, block.lstrip("\n") + "\n" + anchor, 1), encoding="utf-8")
print("已插入 mcp-bizard")
PY
    echo "✅ 写入 $DSH_PATCH（已备份）"
    echo "   验证：dsh --profile web --dump-config | grep -A6 mcp-bizard"
    echo "   profile 设置了 patchReload: live，改动会自动热加载；否则重启 dsh web 生效"
  fi
fi

# ---------- 3. 注册 Codex ----------
if [ "$ONLY_DSH" -eq 0 ]; then
  say "3/4 注册 Codex"
  if [ ! -f "$CODEX_CFG" ]; then
    echo "⚠️  找不到 $CODEX_CFG，跳过"
  elif grep -q "\[mcp_servers.bizard\]" "$CODEX_CFG"; then
    echo "已存在 [mcp_servers.bizard]，跳过"
  else
    cp -a "$CODEX_CFG" "$CODEX_CFG.bak-$(date +%Y%m%d%H%M%S)"
    cat >> "$CODEX_CFG" <<EOF

[mcp_servers.bizard]
command = "$BIN_REAL"
args = []
EOF
    echo "✅ 追加到 $CODEX_CFG（已备份）"
    echo "   验证：codex mcp list | grep bizard"
  fi
fi

# ---------- 4. 冒烟测试 ----------
say "4/4 冒烟测试"
python3 "$(dirname "$0")/02_bizard_client.py" tools 2>&1 | head -6

say "完成"
echo "命令行检索:  python3 02_bizard_client.py search 小提琴图 --zh -n 5"
echo "Agent 内使用: 直接调 mcp__bizard__bizard_search 等 8 个工具"
01_bizard-mcp/02_bizard_client.py python · 12697 bytes 
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Bizard MCP 本地 stdio 客户端（仅用标准库，无需装 mcp SDK）。

用途：脱离 Agent 直接查图。Agent 里用 mcp__bizard__* 工具；命令行/脚本里用这个。

用法：
    python3 02_bizard_client.py cats                     # 列出 40 个类别 + 图数
    python3 02_bizard_client.py search 小提琴图 --zh -n 5  # 中文检索
    python3 02_bizard_client.py search volcano -n 10     # 英文检索
    python3 02_bizard_client.py search heatmap -c Correlation   # 限定类别
    python3 02_bizard_client.py tutorial ViolinPlot-5    # 教程元信息
    python3 02_bizard_client.py code ViolinPlot-5 --lang r      # 可运行代码
    python3 02_bizard_client.py adapt ViolinPlot-5 --lang r --ctx "长表 gene/group/expr"
    python3 02_bizard_client.py index                    # 导出 charts_index.csv（982 图全量索引）

也可直接内联调用：
    from importlib import import_module
    bz = import_module("02_bizard_client")   # 目录名含数字，需按路径导入
    print(bz.call_tool("bizard_search", {"query": "violin", "limit": 3}))
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import os
import select
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys

CMD = os.environ.get("BIZARD_MCP_CMD") or shutil.which("bizard-mcp") or "bizard-mcp"
DEFAULT_TIMEOUT = float(os.environ.get("BIZARD_MCP_TIMEOUT", "60"))


class BizardClient:
    """最小 MCP stdio 客户端：initialize → 调用工具 → 关闭。"""

    def __init__(self, command: str = CMD, timeout: float = DEFAULT_TIMEOUT):
        self.timeout = timeout
        self._id = 0
        self.proc = subprocess.Popen(
            [command],
            stdin=subprocess.PIPE,
            stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
            stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
            text=True,
            bufsize=1,
        )
        self._handshake()

    def _readline(self):
        r, _, _ = select.select([self.proc.stdout], [], [], self.timeout)
        if not r:
            raise TimeoutError(f"bizard-mcp 在 {self.timeout}s 内无响应")
        return self.proc.stdout.readline()

    def _send(self, payload: dict) -> None:
        self.proc.stdin.write(json.dumps(payload) + "\n")
        self.proc.stdin.flush()

    def _rpc(self, method: str, params: dict | None = None) -> dict:
        self._id += 1
        rid = self._id
        self._send({"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": rid, "method": method, "params": params or {}})
        while True:
            line = self._readline()
            if not line:
                raise RuntimeError("bizard-mcp 进程提前退出；检查是否已安装：npm i -g @openbiox/bizard-mcp")
            try:
                msg = json.loads(line)
            except json.JSONDecodeError:
                continue  # 非 JSON 诊断行，跳过
            if msg.get("id") != rid:
                continue  # 服务端通知（如内容包热更新提示），跳过
            if "error" in msg:
                raise RuntimeError(msg["error"].get("message", str(msg["error"])))
            return msg["result"]

    def _handshake(self) -> None:
        result = self._rpc(
            "initialize",
            {
                "protocolVersion": "2024-11-05",
                "capabilities": {},
                "clientInfo": {"name": "hz-bizard-client", "version": "1.0"},
            },
        )
        self.server_info = result.get("serverInfo", {})
        self._send({"jsonrpc": "2.0", "method": "notifications/initialized", "params": {}})

    def call_tool(self, name: str, arguments: dict | None = None) -> str:
        """调用工具，返回原始文本块。工具报错时抛 RuntimeError。"""
        result = self._rpc("tools/call", {"name": name, "arguments": arguments or {}})
        text = "".join(b.get("text", "") for b in result.get("content", []) if b.get("type") == "text")
        if result.get("isError"):
            raise RuntimeError(text.strip() or "未知错误")
        return text

    def list_tools(self) -> list[dict]:
        return self._rpc("tools/list").get("tools", [])

    def read_resource(self, uri: str) -> str:
        result = self._rpc("resources/read", {"uri": uri})
        return "".join(c.get("text", "") for c in result.get("contents", []))

    def close(self) -> None:
        try:
            self.proc.terminate()
            self.proc.wait(timeout=5)
        except Exception:
            self.proc.kill()

    def __enter__(self):
        return self

    def __exit__(self, *exc):
        self.close()


def call_tool(name: str, arguments: dict | None = None) -> str:
    """一次性调用的便捷入口。"""
    with BizardClient() as c:
        return c.call_tool(name, arguments)


def load_json(text: str):
    """工具返回的是 JSON 字符串；纯文本错误信息原样返回字符串。"""
    try:
        return json.loads(text)
    except json.JSONDecodeError:
        return text


# ---------------- 子命令 ----------------

def cmd_cats(args) -> int:
    cats = load_json(call_tool("bizard_list_categories"))
    if isinstance(cats, dict):
        cats = cats.get("items", [])
    cats = sorted(cats, key=lambda c: -c["count"])
    print(f"{'类别':<26}{'中文名':<10}{'图数':>5}")
    print("-" * 43)
    for c in cats:
        print(f"{c['name']:<26}{c.get('nameZh') or '-':<10}{c['count']:>5}")
    print("-" * 43)
    print(f"{'合计':<26}{'':<10}{sum(c['count'] for c in cats):>5}")
    nz = [c["name"] for c in cats if not c.get("nameZh")]
    if nz:
        print(f"\n注意：{len(nz)}/{len(cats)} 个类别无中文名，中文检索时这些类别可能漏召回，改用英文关键词。")
    return 0


def cmd_search(args) -> int:
    payload = {"query": args.query, "limit": args.num}
    if args.zh:
        payload["language"] = "zh"
    if args.category:
        payload["category"] = args.category
    data = load_json(call_tool("bizard_search", payload))
    if isinstance(data, str):
        print(data)
        return 1
    results = data.get("results") or []
    if not results:
        print("无命中。相邻类别建议：")
        for s in (data.get("suggestions") or []):
            print(f"  - {s['id']:<22}{s['name']}  {s['tutorialUrl']}")
        return 0
    for i, r in enumerate(results, 1):
        print(f"[{i}] {r['id']}  |  {r['name']}")
        print(f"    type: {r.get('type', '-')}")
        print(f"    {r.get('tutorialUrl', '')}")
        print(f"    img: {r.get('imageUrl', '')}")
        if r.get("description"):
            print(f"    {r['description'][:120]}")
        print()
    return 0


def cmd_tutorial(args) -> int:
    print(json.dumps(load_json(call_tool("bizard_get_tutorial", {"chartId": args.chart_id})),
                     ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
    return 0


def cmd_code(args) -> int:
    text = call_tool("bizard_get_code", {"chartId": args.chart_id, "language": args.lang})
    data = load_json(text)
    if isinstance(data, str):
        print(data)
        return 1
    if not args.raw:
        print(f"# chart: {args.chart_id}  language: {args.lang}")
        print(f"# packages: {', '.join(data.get('packages') or [])}")
        for u in (data.get("dataUrls") or []):
            print(f"# data: {u}")
        print("# " + "-" * 60)
    print(data.get("code", ""))
    if not args.raw and data.get("license"):
        print(f"\n# License: {data['license']}")
    return 0


def cmd_adapt(args) -> int:
    payload = {"chartId": args.chart_id, "language": args.lang}
    if args.ctx:
        payload["userDataContext"] = args.ctx
    data = load_json(call_tool("bizard_adapt_guidance", payload))
    if isinstance(data, str):
        print(data)
        return 1
    for sec in data.get("sections", []):
        print(f"## {sec['title']}")
        for item in sec.get("items", []):
            print(f"  - {item}")
        print()
    return 0


def _find_snapshot(bundle_path: str | None = None) -> str | None:
    """定位安装包内的内容快照 bundle.json（离线全量数据，含语言/依赖）。"""
    if bundle_path:
        return bundle_path
    if os.environ.get("BIZARD_BUNDLE"):
        return os.environ["BIZARD_BUNDLE"]
    try:
        root = subprocess.run(["npm", "root", "-g"], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30)
        cand = os.path.join(root.stdout.strip(), "@openbiox/bizard-mcp/dist/snapshot/bundle.json")
        if os.path.isfile(cand):
            return cand
    except Exception:
        pass
    return None


def cmd_index(args) -> int:
    """导出全量图例索引 CSV。

    优先读安装包内快照（字段最全，含语言/依赖/图片），
    找不到时退回 catalog 资源（仅 id/名称/类别/链接）。
    """
    import csv

    snap = _find_snapshot(getattr(args, "bundle", None))
    if snap:
        with open(snap, encoding="utf-8") as fh:
            bundle = json.load(fh)
        langs: dict[str, set] = {}
        for s in bundle.get("codeSnippets", []):
            langs.setdefault(s["chartId"], set()).add(s["lang"])
        rows = []
        for ch in bundle["charts"]:
            rows.append([
                ch["id"], ch["name"], ch.get("nameZh") or "",
                ch.get("level1", ""), ch.get("level2", ""), ch.get("type", ""),
                "/".join(sorted(langs.get(ch["id"], []))),
                ch.get("tutorialUrl", ""), ch.get("imageUrl", ""), ch.get("description", ""),
            ])
        header = ["id", "name", "nameZh", "level1", "level2", "type",
                  "languages", "tutorialUrl", "imageUrl", "description"]
        source = f"快照 {snap}"
    else:
        with BizardClient() as c:
            entries = json.loads(c.read_resource("bizard://catalog"))
        rows = [[e["id"], e["name"], "", e.get("level1", ""), e.get("level2", ""),
                 "", "", e.get("tutorialUrl", ""), "", ""] for e in entries]
        header = ["id", "name", "nameZh", "level1", "level2", "type",
                  "languages", "tutorialUrl", "imageUrl", "description"]
        source = "catalog 资源（精简字段）"

    with open(args.out, "w", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
        w = csv.writer(fh)
        w.writerow(header)
        w.writerows(rows)
    print(f"已写入 {args.out}（{len(rows)} 图，来源：{source}）")
    return 0


def cmd_tools(args) -> int:
    with BizardClient() as c:
        print(f"server: {c.server_info}")
        for t in c.list_tools():
            req = (t.get("inputSchema") or {}).get("required") or []
            props = list(((t.get("inputSchema") or {}).get("properties") or {}))
            print(f"\n{t['name']}")
            print(f"  {t.get('description', '').strip()}")
            print(f"  参数: {props}  必填: {req}")
    return 0


def main() -> int:
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Bizard MCP 本地客户端")
    sub = p.add_subparsers(dest="cmd", required=True)

    sp = sub.add_parser("cats", help="列出全部类别与图数")

    sp = sub.add_parser("tools", help="列出工具与参数")

    args = p.parse_args()
    try:

    except (RuntimeError, TimeoutError) as e:

if __name__ == "__main__":

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# ============================================================
# FigureYa 代码拉取（blobless + sparse checkout）
#
# 为什么要特殊处理：上游仓库 6.4 GB，其中 318 个模块的 .Rmd + .R 只有 7 MB，
# 其余全是 .txt/.csv/.gz/RData 数据与渲染产物。直接 git clone 会拉 3.5 GB+。
#
# 本脚本用三层过滤把体积压到 ~76 MB：
#   1. --filter=blob:none  延迟下载文件内容（只取提交与目录树）
#   2. --depth 1           只要最新一次提交，不要历史
#   3. sparse-checkout     只检出代码 + 元数据 + 教程文本（规则见 sparse-checkout.rules）
#
# 用法:
#   ./01_clone.sh              # 首次克隆（约 76 MB）
#   ./01_clone.sh --update     # 已有则更新到上游最新
#   ./01_clone.sh --full       # 需要数据文件时全量检出（约 3.5 GB，谨慎）
# ============================================================
set -euo pipefail
cd "$(dirname "$0")"

REPO="git@github.com:Han-Z02/FigureYa.git"
UPSTREAM="git@github.com:ying-ge/FigureYa.git"
DIR="reference"
RULES="sparse-checkout.rules"

MODE="init"
for a in "$@"; do
  case "$a" in
    --update) MODE="update" ;;
    --full)   MODE="full" ;;
    -h|--help) sed -n '2,20p' "$0"; exit 0 ;;
    *) echo "未知参数: $a"; exit 1 ;;
  esac
done

[ -f "$RULES" ] || { echo "❌ 缺少 $RULES"; exit 1; }

apply_sparse() {
  git sparse-checkout init --no-cone
  cp "../$RULES" .git/info/sparse-checkout
  git checkout main >/dev/null 2>&1 || git read-tree -mu HEAD
}

case "$MODE" in
  init)
    if [ -d "$DIR/.git" ]; then
      echo "⚠️  $DIR 已存在，改用 --update 增量更新"
      exit 0
    fi
    echo "=== 克隆 $REPO（blobless, depth=1）==="
    git clone --filter=blob:none --no-checkout --depth 1 "$REPO" "$DIR"
    cd "$DIR"
    echo "=== 应用 sparse 规则 ==="
    apply_sparse
    ;;
  update)
    [ -d "$DIR/.git" ] || { echo "❌ 还没克隆过，先跑 ./01_clone.sh"; exit 1; }
    cd "$DIR"
    echo "=== 拉取上游最新 ==="
    git fetch --filter=blob:none --depth 1 origin main
    git reset --hard origin/main
    apply_sparse
    ;;
  full)
    [ -d "$DIR/.git" ] || { echo "❌ 还没克隆过，先跑 ./01_clone.sh"; exit 1; }
    cd "$DIR"
    echo "=== 全量检出（约 3.5 GB，会下载所有数据文件）==="
    read -rp "确认继续？[y/N] " ans
    [ "$ans" = "y" ] || exit 0
    git sparse-checkout disable
    git checkout main
    ;;
esac

cd - >/dev/null
echo
echo "=== 体积 ==="
du -sh "$DIR"
echo
echo "=== 内容 ==="
echo "模块数      : $(ls -d "$DIR"/FigureYa*/ 2>/dev/null | wc -l)"
echo "Rmd         : $(find "$DIR" -name '*.Rmd' -not -path '*/.git/*' | wc -l)"
echo "R 脚本      : $(find "$DIR" -name '*.R' -not -path '*/.git/*' | wc -l)"
echo "教程文本    : $(ls "$DIR"/texts 2>/dev/null | wc -l)"
echo
echo "下一步: python3 03_build_index.py     # 重建索引"

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
FigureYa 索引生成器 —— 从 clone 的 reference/ 解析 317 个模块，输出可检索索引。

输入（均在 reference/ 下）：
    chapters.json      模块清单：folder / html / thumb / text
    file_list.json     每模块的文件列表（判断有无 Rmd / R 脚本）
    texts/*.txt        每个模块的教程全文（含需求描述、应用场景、完整代码）

输出：
    modules_index.csv  一行一个模块：编号、Rmd、脚本数、需求描述、教程与缩略图链接
    categories.md      按 categories.txt 的分组盘点

用法：
    python3 03_build_index.py                       # 在 02_figureya/ 下执行
    python3 03_build_index.py --ref reference --out .
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import csv
import json
import os
import re
import sys

SITE = "https://ying-ge.github.io/FigureYa"
REPO = "https://github.com/Han-Z02/FigureYa"

# 需求段落的结束标志（下一小节标题）
_END_MARKERS = re.compile(
    r"(应用场景|Application\s*scenarios?|环境设置|Environment\s*settings?|"
    r"数据准备|Data\s*preparation|代码|Code\b|\n\d+\n)",
    re.I,
)
# 正文开头要跳过的元信息行
_SKIP_LINE = re.compile(
    r"^(FigureYa\S*|Code|Show All Code|Hide All Code|Author\(s\)|Reviewer\(s\)|"
    r"Date|Academic Citation|If you use this code|Xiaofan Lu|我们的宗旨|:|"
    r"\d+\s*$|\d+\s*[A-Z])",
    re.I,
)
# 引用/致谢段落（出现在需求段之前，需先剔除）
_CITATION_BLOCK = re.compile(
    r"(?:If you use this code.*?https://doi\.org/\S+|"
    r"Academic Citation.*?(?=需求描述|Requirement|$)|"
    r"Xiaofan Lu,\s*et al\..*?iMetaMed\.?|"
    r"\d+\s*Framework for Enhancing.*?iMetaMed\.?)",
    re.S | re.I,
)


def _norm(text: str) -> str:
    return re.sub(r"\s+", " ", text).strip()


def _clean_head(raw: str) -> str:
    """砍掉正文开头的引用块与编号小节标号，避免污染需求描述。"""
    # 先把首个「需求描述」之前的内容整体裁掉前缀噪声
    idx = raw.lower().find("需求描述")
    if idx == -1:
        idx = raw.lower().find("requirement")
    if idx > 0:
        head, tail = raw[:idx], raw[idx:]
        # 若前半段包含引用信息，直接丢弃；否则保留（老模块的需求常写在开头）
        if _CITATION_BLOCK.search(head) or "doi.org" in head.lower() or "iMetaMed" in head:
            prefix = "需求描述 " if "需求描述" in tail[:12] else ""
            raw = prefix + tail
    return _CITATION_BLOCK.sub("", raw)


def extract_needs(path: str) -> str:
    """从教程全文里抠出「需求描述 / Requirement」段落。

    优先按小节标题切片；没有该标题的老模块，跳过元信息后取正文前几行。
    """
    if not path or not os.path.isfile(path):
        return ""
    raw = _clean_head(open(path, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace").read())

    m = re.search(
        r"需求描述\s*(?:Requirement)?\s*(?:description)?(.*)", raw, re.S | re.I
    )
    if m:
        body = m.group(1)
        end = _END_MARKERS.search(body)
        if end:
            body = body[: end.start()]
        body = _norm(body)
        # 反复剥离开头的标题词（原文常连续出现「需求描述 需求描述 Requirement description」）
        _HEAD = re.compile(
            r"^(?:需求描述|Requirement(?:\s*Description)?|Description[s]?|描述)\s*",
            re.I,
        )
        for _ in range(6):
            stripped = _HEAD.sub("", body)
            if stripped == body:
                break
            body = stripped
        if len(body) > 20:
            return body[:400]
    # 兜底：跳过元信息，取正文
    picked: list[str] = []
    for line in raw.split("\n")[:120]:
        ls = line.strip()
        if not ls or _SKIP_LINE.search(ls):
            continue
        if "doi.org" in ls.lower() or "cite our publication" in ls.lower():
            continue
        picked.append(ls)
        if len(" ".join(picked)) > 320:
            break
    return _norm(" ".join(picked))[:400]


def load_modules(ref: str) -> list[dict]:
    """按模块（folder）聚合 chapters。

    chapters.json 里一个模块可能有多条记录（多分册 Rmd，如 FigureYa63pubmedMiningV2
    有 3 章），索引应按模块去重，分册数单独记一列。
    """
    ch_path = os.path.join(ref, "chapters.json")
    fl_path = os.path.join(ref, "file_list.json")
    if not os.path.isfile(ch_path):
        sys.exit(f"找不到 {ch_path}；请先在 {os.path.dirname(ref)} 执行 01_clone.sh")
    chapters = json.load(open(ch_path, encoding="utf-8"))
    file_list = json.load(open(fl_path, encoding="utf-8")) if os.path.isfile(fl_path) else {}

    grouped: dict[str, list[dict]] = {}
    for c in chapters:
        grouped.setdefault(c["folder"], []).append(c)

    rows = []
    for folder, chapters_of in grouped.items():
        files = [f["name"] for f in file_list.get(folder, [])]
        rmd = next((f for f in files if f.lower().endswith(".rmd")), "")
        scripts = [
            f for f in files
            if f.lower().endswith((".r", ".py")) and f != "install_dependencies.R"
        ]
        # 需求描述取第一份非空的分册
        needs, site = "", ""
        for c in chapters_of:
            if not needs and c.get("text"):
                needs = extract_needs(os.path.join(ref, c["text"]))
            if not site and c.get("html"):
                site = f"{SITE}/{c['html']}"
        # html 字段缺失时用实际 Rmd 文件名拼（有 7 个模块 Rmd 名与目录名不同，
        # 如 FigureYa8radar/FigureYa8radarChart.Rmd，按目录名拼会 404）
        if not site and rmd:
            site = f"{SITE}/{folder}/{os.path.splitext(rmd)[0]}.html"
        thumb = next((c["thumb"] for c in chapters_of if c.get("thumb")), "")

        rows.append(
            {
                "id": folder,
                "rmd": rmd,
                "n_scripts": len(scripts),
                "has_install": "install_dependencies.R" in files,
                "n_files": len(files),
                "n_chapters": len(chapters_of),
                "needs": needs,
                "site": site,
                "thumb": f"{REPO}/raw/main/{thumb}" if thumb else "",
            }
        )
    rows.sort(key=lambda r: r["id"])
    return rows


def write_csv(rows: list[dict], out: str) -> str:
    path = os.path.join(out, "modules_index.csv")
    with open(path, "w", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
        w = csv.writer(fh)
        w.writerow(["id", "rmd", "n_scripts", "has_install", "n_files",
                    "n_chapters", "needs", "site", "thumb"])
        for r in rows:
            w.writerow([
                r["id"], r["rmd"], r["n_scripts"], "Y" if r["has_install"] else "N",
                r["n_files"], r["n_chapters"], r["needs"], r["site"], r["thumb"],
            ])
    return path


def write_categories(ref: str, out: str, rows: list[dict]) -> str:
    """把 categories.txt 的主题分组转成 markdown。

    文件结构：开头是 6 个主题的「标题 + 副标题」总览（各占一行，无链接），
    空行之后进入正文，每组以 `主题，公众号链接` 开头，下面跟模块行。

    注意：分隔符是全角逗号「，」，而主题标题自身也含它
    （如「圆圈图小结｜美图如云，理性选择，https://...」），
    所以不能用 split(',')，必须先按 "http" 切开再取前半段作标题。
    """
    src = os.path.join(ref, "categories.txt")
    if not os.path.isfile(src):
        return ""
    ids = {r["id"] for r in rows}

    sections: list[tuple[str, str, list[str]]] = []
    cur_title, cur_link, cur_mods = None, "", []

    for raw in open(src, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace"):
        line = raw.strip().lstrip("\ufeff")
        if not line:
            continue
        if line.startswith("FigureYa"):
            if cur_title is not None:
                cur_mods.append(line)
            continue
        if "http" not in line:
            continue        # 开头的总览双行标题，跳过
        # 主题行
        if cur_title is not None:
            sections.append((cur_title, cur_link, cur_mods))
        head, _, url = line.partition("http")
        url = "http" + url
        title = head.rstrip("，, ").strip()
        cur_title, cur_link, cur_mods = title, url.strip(), []
    if cur_title is not None:
        sections.append((cur_title, cur_link, cur_mods))

    lines = [
        "# FigureYa 主题分组盘点",
        "",
        "> 由 `03_build_index.py` 从仓库 `categories.txt` 生成；分组与顺序遵循上游，"
        "模块名已链接到在线教程页。",
        "",
    ]
    total_listed = 0
    for title, link, mods in sections:
        present = [m for m in mods if m in ids]
        missing = [m for m in mods if m not in ids]
        total_listed += len(present)
        lines.append(f"## {title}")
        lines.append("")
        if link:
            lines.append(f"> 主题小结：{link}")
            lines.append("")
        lines.append(f"**{len(present)} 个模块**")
        lines.append("")
        for m in present:
            lines.append(f"- [`{m}`]({SITE}/{m}/{m}.html)")
        if missing:
            lines.append("")
            lines.append(f"> 仓库中未找到（可能已改名/删除）：{', '.join(missing)}")
        lines.append("")

    covered = {m for _, _, mods in sections for m in mods}
    leftover = sorted(ids - covered)
    lines.append("## 未归入主题的模块")
    lines.append("")
    lines.append(
        f"**{len(leftover)} 个模块** —— `categories.txt` 只整理了 6 个主题，"
        "其余模块未归类（多为后期新增或专项工具），可按需自行分组。"
    )
    lines.append("")
    for m in leftover:
        lines.append(f"- [`{m}`]({SITE}/{m}/{m}.html)")
    lines.append("")

    path = os.path.join(out, "categories.md")
    open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8").write("\n".join(lines) + "\n")
    print(f"主题分组    : {len(sections)} 组覆盖 {total_listed} 模块；未归类 {len(leftover)}")
    return path


def main() -> int:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="生成 FigureYa 模块索引")
    ap.add_argument("--ref", default="reference", help="clone 出来的仓库目录")
    ap.add_argument("--out", default=".", help="索引输出目录")
    a = ap.parse_args()

    rows = load_modules(a.ref)
    csv_path = write_csv(rows, a.out)
    cat_path = write_categories(a.ref, a.out, rows)

    with_rmd = sum(1 for r in rows if r["rmd"])
    with_needs = sum(1 for r in rows if r["needs"])
    print(f"模块总数    : {len(rows)}")
    print(f"有 Rmd 主脚本: {with_rmd}")
    print(f"有需求描述  : {with_needs}")
    print(f"平均脚本数  : {sum(r['n_scripts'] for r in rows) / max(len(rows), 1):.2f}")
    print(f"已写出      : {csv_path}")
    if cat_path:
        print(f"            : {cat_path}")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
02_figureya/04_build_bundle.py python · 10947 bytes 
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
FigureYa 内容打包器 —— 把 reference/ 下的 Rmd 与教程全文压成单个 JSON 快照。

为什么要打包：MCP server 每次启动都去扫 313 个 Rmd（328 个文件、4569 个 chunk）
要 1-2 秒且依赖 reference/ 目录存在。打包成一个 bundle.json 后可随包分发，
server 启动只需 json.load，且离线可用 —— 与 Bizard MCP 的做法一致。

输入（reference/ 下，由 01_clone.sh 拉取）：
    FigureYa*/…Rmd      主脚本 + 代码块
    FigureYa*/install_dependencies.R
    chapters.json       模块 → html/thumb/text 映射
    texts/*.txt         教程全文（含需求描述、应用场景）
    categories.txt      6 个主题分组

输出：
    snapshot/bundle.json

用法：
    python3 build_bundle.py                 # 默认读 ./reference，写 ./snapshot
    python3 build_bundle.py --ref reference --out snapshot
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import glob
import json
import os
import re
import sys

# ---- Rmd 解析正则 ----
# ```{r ...} 或 ```{r} —— 支持 chunk 选项里的任意内容（含引号、逗号）
CHUNK_RE = re.compile(r"^```\{r([^}]*)\}[ \t]*\r?\n(.*?)^```[ \t]*$", re.M | re.S)
HEADING_RE = re.compile(r"^(#{1,4})[ \t]+(.+?)[ \t]*#*[ \t]*$", re.M)
PKG_RE = re.compile(
    r'(?:library|require|requireNamespace)\(\s*["\']?([A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9._]*)["\']?\s*[,)]'
)
# install_dependencies.R 里的包清单
DEPS_CRAN_RE = re.compile(r"cran_packages\s*<-\s*c\(([^)]*)\)", re.S)
DEPS_BIOC_RE = re.compile(r"bioc_packages\s*<-\s*c\(([^)]*)\)", re.S)

# 需求描述 / 应用场景这些标准节，用来给 section 打标签
SECTION_ALIASES = {
    "requirement": ("需求描述", "requirement", "需求"),
    "scenario": ("应用场景", "使用场景", "application scenario", "usage scenario", "scenario"),
    "environment": ("环境设置", "environment setting"),
    "input": ("输入文件", "输入数据", "input data", "input file", "输入文件的获得"),
    "draw": ("开始画图", "start to draw", "draw"),
    "postprocess": ("后期处理", "post-processing", "postprocess"),
}


def _strip_chunks(text: str) -> str:
    """移除代码块，只留说明性 Markdown。

    必须做这一步：R chunk 里的 `# 注释` 会被标题正则误判成 Markdown 标题
    （FigureYa101PCA 有 106 个「标题」，其中绝大多数是 chunk 内的注释）。
    """
    return CHUNK_RE.sub("", text)


def split_frontmatter(text: str) -> tuple[dict, str]:
    """拆 YAML front matter。只做浅解析 —— 不引入 PyYAML 依赖。"""
    if not text.startswith("---"):
        return {}, text
    end = text.find("\n---", 3)
    if end == -1:
        return {}, text
    head = text[3:end]
    body = text[end + 4 :]
    fm: dict = {}
    m = re.search(r'^title:\s*["\']?(.+?)["\']?\s*$', head, re.M)
    if m:
        fm["title"] = m.group(1)
    m = re.search(r'^\s*author:\s*["\']?(.+?)["\']?\s*$', head, re.M)
    if m:
        fm["author"] = m.group(1)
    m = re.search(r'^\s*reviewer:\s*["\']?(.+?)["\']?\s*$', head, re.M)
    if m:
        fm["reviewer"] = m.group(1)
    return fm, body


def parse_sections(body_no_chunks: str) -> list[dict]:
    """按 ## 级标题切分说明性章节。返回 [{title, level, content}]。"""
    marks = [(m.start(), len(m.group(1)), m.group(2).strip()) for m in HEADING_RE.finditer(body_no_chunks)]
    if not marks:
        return []
    out = []
    for i, (pos, level, title) in enumerate(marks):
        end = marks[i + 1][0] if i + 1 < len(marks) else len(body_no_chunks)
        content = body_no_chunks[pos:end]
        content = content.split("\n", 1)[1] if "\n" in content else ""
        content = re.sub(r"\n{3,}", "\n\n", content).strip()
        if not content or not title:
            continue
        out.append({"title": title, "level": level, "content": content[:4000]})
    return out


def tag_section(title: str) -> str | None:
    """给标准节打标签，便于按语义取「需求描述」而不用猜标题写法。"""
    low = title.lower()
    for tag, keys in SECTION_ALIASES.items():
        if any(k.lower() in low for k in keys):
            return tag
    return None


def parse_chunks(text: str) -> list[dict]:
    """抽取 R 代码块。skip setup/eval=FALSE 这类不产生内容的块单列标记。"""
    chunks = []
    for i, m in enumerate(CHUNK_RE.finditer(text)):
        header = m.group(1).strip().strip(",")
        code = m.group(2).rstrip()
        if not code.strip():
            continue
        label = ""
        lm = re.match(r"^([A-Za-z0-9_.-]+)", header)
        if lm:
            label = lm.group(1)
        chunks.append(
            {
                "i": len(chunks),
                "label": label,
                "header": header[:200],
                "setup": bool(re.search(r"include\s*=\s*FALSE|eval\s*=\s*FALSE", header, re.I)),
                "code": code[:20000],
                "lines": code.count("\n") + 1,
            }
        )
    return chunks


def extract_packages(text: str, deps_script: str) -> dict:
    """从 Rmd 的 library() 调用 + install_dependencies.R 的清单合并出依赖。"""
    pkgs = set(PKG_RE.findall(text))
    cran, bioc = [], []
    for pat, bucket in ((DEPS_CRAN_RE, cran), (DEPS_BIOC_RE, bioc)):
        m = pat.search(deps_script or "")
        if m:
            bucket.extend(
                x.strip().strip("\"'")
                for x in m.group(1).split(",")
                if x.strip().strip("\"'")
            )
    pkgs.update(cran)
    pkgs.update(bioc)
    # 过滤明显不是包名的
    bad = {"install", "library", "require", "c", "TRUE", "FALSE", "T", "F"}
    return {
        "all": sorted(p for p in pkgs if p and p not in bad),
        "cran": sorted(set(cran)),
        "bioc": sorted(set(bioc)),
    }


def build(ref: str) -> dict:
    ch_path = os.path.join(ref, "chapters.json")
    chapters = json.load(open(ch_path, encoding="utf-8")) if os.path.isfile(ch_path) else []

    # folder -> 章节记录（多分册）
    by_folder: dict[str, list[dict]] = {}
    for c in chapters:
        by_folder.setdefault(c["folder"], []).append(c)

    # 目录名集合以实际 Rmd 所在目录为准
    folders = sorted(
        {os.path.basename(os.path.dirname(p)) for p in glob.glob(os.path.join(ref, "FigureYa*", "*.Rmd"))}
    )

    modules = []
    for folder in folders:
        mdir = os.path.join(ref, folder)
        rmd_paths = sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(mdir, "*.Rmd")))
        if not rmd_paths:
            continue
        rmd_path = rmd_paths[0]
        raw = open(rmd_path, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace").read()
        fm, body = split_frontmatter(raw)
        body_no_chunks = _strip_chunks(body)

        deps_path = os.path.join(mdir, "install_dependencies.R")
        deps_script = open(deps_path, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace").read() if os.path.isfile(deps_path) else ""

        chapters_of = by_folder.get(folder, [])
        thumb = next((c["thumb"] for c in chapters_of if c.get("thumb")), "")
        html = next((c["html"] for c in chapters_of if c.get("html")), "")

        sections = parse_sections(body_no_chunks)
        for s in sections:
            s["tag"] = tag_section(s["title"])

        modules.append(
            {
                "id": folder,
                "rmd": os.path.basename(rmd_path),
                "title": fm.get("title", folder),
                "author": fm.get("author", ""),
                "reviewer": fm.get("reviewer", ""),
                "site": f"https://ying-ge.github.io/FigureYa/{html}" if html else "",
                "thumb": f"https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Han-Z02/FigureYa/main/{thumb}" if thumb else "",
                "n_chapters": len(chapters_of),
                "sections": sections,
                "chunks": parse_chunks(raw),
                "packages": extract_packages(raw, deps_script),
                "has_install_script": bool(deps_script),
                "deps_script": deps_script[:8000],
                "extra_scripts": sorted(
                    os.path.basename(p)
                    for p in glob.glob(os.path.join(mdir, "*.R"))
                    if os.path.basename(p) != "install_dependencies.R"
                )[:40],
            }
        )

    # 主题分组
    categories = []
    cat_path = os.path.join(ref, "categories.txt")
    if os.path.isfile(cat_path):
        cur = None
        for raw_line in open(cat_path, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace"):
            line = raw_line.strip().lstrip("\ufeff")
            if not line:
                continue
            if line.startswith("FigureYa"):
                if cur:
                    cur["modules"].append(line)
                continue
            if "http" not in line:
                continue
            if cur:
                categories.append(cur)
            head, _, url = line.partition("http")
            cur = {"name": head.rstrip("，, ").strip(), "url": ("http" + url).strip(), "modules": []}
        if cur:
            categories.append(cur)

    return {
        "meta": {
            "source": "https://github.com/ying-ge/FigureYa",
            "fork": "https://github.com/Han-Z02/FigureYa",
            "site": "https://ying-ge.github.io/FigureYa/",
            "license": "CC BY-NC-SA 4.0",
            "citation": "Lu X, et al. (2025). FigureYa: A Standardized Visualization Framework "
                        "for Enhancing Biomedical Data Interpretation and Research Efficiency. "
                        "iMetaMed. https://doi.org/10.1002/imm3.70005",
            "doi": "10.1002/imm3.70005",
            "n_modules": len(modules),
        },
        "categories": categories,
        "modules": modules,
    }


def main() -> int:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="打包 FigureYa 内容快照")
    ap.add_argument("--ref", default="reference")
    ap.add_argument("--out", default="snapshot")
    a = ap.parse_args()

    if not os.path.isdir(a.ref):
        sys.exit(f"找不到 {a.ref}/；先跑 ./01_clone.sh")

    bundle = build(a.ref)
    os.makedirs(a.out, exist_ok=True)
    path = os.path.join(a.out, "bundle.json")
    with open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
        json.dump(bundle, fh, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":"))

    size = os.path.getsize(path) / 1024 / 1024
    n_chunk = sum(len(m["chunks"]) for m in bundle["modules"])
    n_sec = sum(len(m["sections"]) for m in bundle["modules"])
    n_pkg = sum(len(m["packages"]["all"]) for m in bundle["modules"])
    print(f"模块      : {len(bundle['modules'])}")
    print(f"代码块    : {n_chunk}")
    print(f"说明章节  : {n_sec}")
    print(f"依赖声明项: {n_pkg}")
    print(f"主题分组  : {len(bundle['categories'])}")
    print(f"快照      : {path}  ({size:.1f} MB)")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
02_figureya/05_mcp_server.py python · 16842 bytes 
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
FigureYa MCP Server —— 把 313 个 R Markdown 图表模板变成可检索、可取码的 MCP 服务。

设计取舍（与 Bizard MCP 对齐，便于两者并列使用）：
  - 内容随包分发（snapshot/bundle.json，5.8 MB），启动只需 json.load，离线可用
  - 只读服务，不执行任何 R 代码；取回的代码由宿主 Agent/用户自己跑
  - 工具名 figureya_*，与 bizard_* 不冲突

工具：
  figureya_search           关键词检索模块（中英双语，命中标题/需求/依赖/代码）
  figureya_list_categories  6 个主题分组
  figureya_get_module       模块元信息：章节结构、依赖、代码块清单
  figureya_get_code         取可运行 R 代码（整篇 Rmd 或指定代码块）
  figureya_adapt_guidance   把模板适配到自己数据的检查清单
  figureya_cite             引用与许可

资源：
  figureya://catalog        模块清单 JSON
  figureya://module/{id}    单个模块完整内容

用法：
  python3 05_mcp_server.py                 # stdio（默认）
  python3 05_mcp_server.py --selftest      # 自检，不启动服务
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import os
import re
import sys

try:
    from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP
except ImportError:  # pragma: no cover
    sys.exit("缺少 mcp SDK：pip install 'mcp[cli]'")

# FastMCP/mcp SDK 用标准 logging 往 stderr 打每个请求的 INFO（Processing request of type
# ...）。DSH/Codex 把 MCP 的 stderr 当错误日志收，逐条刷屏却看不出真问题。
# 这里把 mcp 相关 logger 抬到 WARNING，只保留异常。
import logging as _logging

for _name in ("mcp", "mcp.server", "mcp.server.lowlevel", "fastmcp", "httpx"):
    _logging.getLogger(_name).setLevel(_logging.WARNING)

HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
SNAPSHOT = os.environ.get("FIGUREYA_BUNDLE") or os.path.join(HERE, "snapshot", "bundle.json")
SERVER_NAME = "figureya"
SEARCH_LIMIT_MAX = 25

mcp = FastMCP("figureya")

_bundle: dict | None = None


def get_bundle() -> dict:
    """惰性加载快照。找不到时给出可操作的报错，而不是空列表。"""
    global _bundle
    if _bundle is None:
        if not os.path.isfile(SNAPSHOT):
            raise RuntimeError(
                f"找不到内容快照 {SNAPSHOT}。请先执行：\n"
                "  ./01_clone.sh              # 拉取 FigureYa 源码\n"
                "  python3 04_build_bundle.py # 生成 snapshot/bundle.json"
            )
        with open(SNAPSHOT, encoding="utf-8") as fh:
            _bundle = json.load(fh)
    return _bundle


def _mods() -> list[dict]:
    return get_bundle()["modules"]


def _by_id(mid: str) -> dict:
    for m in _mods():
        if m["id"] == mid:
            return m
    raise ValueError(f"未知模块 ID: {mid}（用 figureya_search 查可用 ID）")


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- 检索

def _haystack(m: dict) -> str:
    """拼出检索文本。需求描述权重最高，代码只取前 2000 字避免噪声。"""
    parts = [m["id"], m["title"], m.get("author", "")]
    for s in m["sections"]:
        if s.get("tag") in ("requirement", "scenario"):
            parts.append(s["title"])
            parts.append(s["content"])
    for s in m["sections"]:
        if s.get("tag") not in ("requirement", "scenario"):
            parts.append(s["title"])
    parts.extend(m["packages"]["all"])
    for c in m["chunks"][:6]:
        parts.append(c["code"][:2000])
    return "\n".join(parts).lower()


def _score(m: dict, terms: list[str], hay: str | None = None) -> int:
    """加权打分：模块 ID 命中权重最高，其次标题/需求，最后正文与代码。"""
    hay = hay if hay is not None else _haystack(m)
    low_id = m["id"].lower()
    low_title = m["title"].lower()
    req = "\n".join(s["content"] for s in m["sections"] if s.get("tag") == "requirement").lower()
    score = 0
    for t in terms:
        if t in low_id:
            score += 10
        if t in low_title:
            score += 6
        if t in req:
            score += 4
        if t in hay:
            score += 1
    return score


@mcp.tool()
def figureya_search(query: str, limit: int = 5, category: str = "") -> str:
    """检索 FigureYa 图表模板（中英文均可）。

    在模块编号、标题、需求描述、依赖包名和代码里做加权匹配。
    零命中时会按主题分组给出相邻建议。

    Args:
        query: 检索词，如「生存曲线」「circos」「WGCNA」「radar」
        limit: 返回条数 1-25，默认 5
        category: 限定主题分组名（先跑 figureya_list_categories 看可选值）
    """
    limit = max(1, min(int(limit), SEARCH_LIMIT_MAX))
    terms = [t for t in re.split(r"[\s,，、]+", query.strip().lower()) if len(t) >= 2]
    if not terms:
        return json.dumps({"error": "query 太短，至少 2 个字符"}, ensure_ascii=False)

    pool = _mods()
    if category:
        cats = get_bundle()["categories"]
        hit = next((c for c in cats if category.lower() in c["name"].lower()), None)
        if hit:
            allowed = set(hit["modules"])
            pool = [m for m in pool if m["id"] in allowed]
        else:
            return json.dumps(
                {
                    "error": f"未知主题 {category!r}",
                    "available": [c["name"] for c in cats],
                },
                ensure_ascii=False,
            )

    scored = []
    for m in pool:
        s = _score(m, terms)
        if s > 0:
            scored.append((s, m))
    scored.sort(key=lambda x: (-x[0], x[1]["id"]))

    if not scored:
        req = " ".join(s["content"] for s in [] )  # 占位，保持结构一致
        del req
        return json.dumps(
            {
                "results": [],
                "hint": "换英文关键词，或先 figureya_list_categories 看主题",
                "sample_ids": [m["id"] for m in pool[:5]],
            },
            ensure_ascii=False,
        )

    out = []
    for s, m in scored[:limit]:
        need = next((x["content"] for x in m["sections"] if x.get("tag") == "requirement"), "")
        out.append(
            {
                "id": m["id"],
                "title": m["title"],
                "score": s,
                "requirement": need[:400],
                "packages": m["packages"]["all"][:12],
                "n_chunks": len(m["chunks"]),
                "site": m["site"],
                "thumb": m["thumb"],
            }
        )
    return json.dumps({"results": out, "total_matched": len(scored)}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)


@mcp.tool()
def figureya_list_categories() -> str:
    """列出 6 个主题分组及每组模块数与公众号小结链接。"""
    cats = get_bundle()["categories"]
    items = [
        {
            "name": c["name"],
            "url": c["url"],
            "count": len([x for x in c["modules"] if any(m["id"] == x for m in _mods())]),
            "modules": c["modules"],
        }
        for c in cats
    ]
    covered = {x for c in cats for x in c["modules"]}
    leftover = [m["id"] for m in _mods() if m["id"] not in covered]
    return json.dumps(
        {"items": items, "uncategorized_count": len(leftover)}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2
    )


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- 取内容

@mcp.tool()
def figureya_get_module(module_id: str, include_sections: bool = True) -> str:
    """取单个模块的结构化元信息：章节标题、依赖包、代码块清单、在线链接。

    不返回完整代码（用 figureya_get_code）。

    Args:
        module_id: 模块 ID，如 FigureYa101PCA
        include_sections: 是否返回章节正文（默认 True；只要目录可设 false）
    """
    m = _by_id(module_id)
    payload = {
        "id": m["id"],
        "title": m["title"],
        "author": m["author"],
        "reviewer": m["reviewer"],
        "site": m["site"],
        "thumb": m["thumb"],
        "packages": m["packages"],
        "has_install_script": m["has_install_script"],
        "extra_scripts": m["extra_scripts"],
        "chunks": [
            {"i": c["i"], "label": c["label"], "lines": c["lines"], "setup": c["setup"]}
            for c in m["chunks"]
        ],
    }
    if include_sections:
        payload["sections"] = [
            {"title": s["title"], "tag": s.get("tag"), "content": s["content"][:2000]}
            for s in m["sections"]
        ]
    return json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)


@mcp.tool()
def figureya_get_code(module_id: str, chunk: int = -1, include_deps: bool = True) -> str:
    """取可运行的 R 代码。

    Args:
        module_id: 模块 ID
        chunk: 代码块序号（0 起）。-1 表示返回整篇 Rmd 的全部代码块；也可用 figureya_get_module 查清单
        include_deps: 是否附带 install_dependencies.R（默认 True，照着跑可自动装依赖）
    """
    m = _by_id(module_id)
    chunks = m["chunks"]
    if not chunks:
        return json.dumps({"error": f"{module_id} 没有可提取的 R 代码块"}, ensure_ascii=False)

    if chunk >= 0:
        if chunk >= len(chunks):
            return json.dumps(
                {"error": f"chunk 超出范围，该模块只有 {len(chunks)} 个代码块（0-{len(chunks)-1}）"},
                ensure_ascii=False,
            )
        picked = [chunks[chunk]]
    else:
        picked = chunks

    out = {
        "id": m["id"],
        "rmd": m["rmd"],
        "site": m["site"],
        "packages": m["packages"],
        "license": "CC BY-NC-SA 4.0",
        "code_blocks": [{"i": c["i"], "label": c["label"], "code": c["code"]} for c in picked],
    }
    if include_deps and m["has_install_script"]:
        out["install_dependencies.R"] = m["deps_script"]
    out["run_hint"] = (
        f"把代码存为 {m['rmd']} 同目录下的脚本，先 source(\"install_dependencies.R\"), "
        "再依次运行各代码块；数据文件需从上游仓库取（本地 sparse 检出不含数据）"
    )
    return json.dumps(out, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)


@mcp.tool()
def figureya_adapt_guidance(module_id: str, user_data_context: str = "") -> str:
    """把模板适配到自己数据的检查清单。

    基于该模块实际用到的包、代码块结构和需求描述给出针对性提示。

    Args:
        module_id: 模块 ID
        user_data_context: 可选，描述你的数据形状，如「长表 gene/group/expr，3 组」
    """
    m = _by_id(module_id)
    need = next((s["content"] for s in m["sections"] if s.get("tag") == "requirement"), "")
    scen = next((s["content"] for s in m["sections"] if s.get("tag") == "scenario"), "")
    inp = [s["content"][:600] for s in m["sections"] if s.get("tag") == "input"]

    pkgs = m["packages"]
    checks = [
        {
            "title": "依赖安装",
            "items": [
                f"CRAN: {', '.join(pkgs['cran']) or '（脚本内自动检测）'}",
                f"Bioconductor: {', '.join(pkgs['bioc']) or '（无）'}",
                '先跑 source("install_dependencies.R")；该脚本用 install.packages + BiocManager 双通道',
                f"代码块共 {len(m['chunks'])} 个，其中 setup 块 {sum(1 for c in m['chunks'] if c['setup'])} 个（改 knitr 选项，非绘图逻辑）",
            ],
        },
        {
            "title": "输入数据",
            "items": (
                [f"模板对输入的要求：{x}" for x in inp]
                or ["该模块未单列「输入文件」章节，看代码块的 read.* 调用确认列名与格式"]
            )
            + [
                "数据文件不在本地 sparse 检出里（占上游 6.4 GB），需要时 "
                "`./01_clone.sh --full` 或从在线教程页下载 easy_input_*.csv"
            ],
        },
        {
            "title": "参数映射",
            "items": [
                "把 read.* 的路径换成你的文件；列名按 aes()/索引里的写法对齐",
                "先原样跑通再改：一次只改一个参数，避免样式与数据错误混在一起",
            ],
        },
        {
            "title": "常见失败",
            "items": [
                "列名不匹配 → 用 colnames()/str() 核对后再套 aes()",
                "分组变量被读成字符 → factor(x, levels=你的顺序)，否则图例与检验顺序错",
                "Bioconductor 包版本与 R 版本冲突 → 先 BiocManager::valid() 再装",
                "字体/中文乱码 → 出 PDF 前设 showtext 或改用 cairo_pdf",
            ],
        },
    ]
    if need:
        checks.insert(
            0,
            {
                "title": "这个模板要解决什么",
                "items": [need[:600]] + ([f"使用场景：{scen[:400]}"] if scen else []),
            },
        )
    if user_data_context:
        checks.append(
            {
                "title": "针对你的数据",
                "items": [
                    f"你的描述：{user_data_context}",
                    "对照上面的「输入数据」逐项确认格式是否满足",
                    f"若结构差异大，先用 figureya_search 找更接近的模块（同主题共 "
                    f"{len(m['sections'])} 个章节可参考）",
                ],
            }
        )
    return json.dumps(
        {"module": m["id"], "sections": checks, "site": m["site"]}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2
    )


@mcp.tool()
def figureya_cite(module_id: str = "", format: str = "text") -> str:
    """引用信息与许可声明。

    Args:
        module_id: 可选，指定模块则附带该模块的在线地址
        format: text | bibtex
    """
    meta = get_bundle()["meta"]
    if format == "bibtex":
        body = (
            "@article{lu2025figureya,\n"
            "  title={FigureYa: A Standardized Visualization Framework for Enhancing "
            "Biomedical Data Interpretation and Research Efficiency},\n"
            "  author={Lu, Xiaofan and others},\n"
            "  journal={iMetaMed},\n"
            "  year={2025},\n"
            "  doi={10.1002/imm3.70005}\n"
            "}"
        )
    else:
        body = meta["citation"]
    out = {"citation": body, "doi": meta["doi"], "license": meta["license"]}
    if module_id:
        try:
            out["module"] = _by_id(module_id)["site"]
        except ValueError as e:
            out["module_error"] = str(e)
    out["license_note"] = "CC BY-NC-SA 4.0：非商用，转载/改编需署名并以相同许可共享"
    return json.dumps(out, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- 资源

@mcp.resource("figureya://catalog")
def catalog() -> str:
    """全部模块清单（id / 标题 / 依赖 / 在线链接）。"""
    return json.dumps(
        [
            {
                "id": m["id"],
                "title": m["title"],
                "packages": m["packages"]["all"][:8],
                "site": m["site"],
            }
            for m in _mods()
        ],
        ensure_ascii=False,
    )


@mcp.resource("figureya://module/{module_id}")
def module_resource(module_id: str) -> str:
    """单个模块的完整内容（含全部代码）。"""
    m = _by_id(module_id)
    return json.dumps(m, ensure_ascii=False)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- 自检

def selftest() -> int:
    b = get_bundle()
    print(f"快照      : {SNAPSHOT} ({os.path.getsize(SNAPSHOT)/1024/1024:.1f} MB)")
    print(f"模块      : {len(b['modules'])}")
    print(f"主题分组  : {len(b['categories'])}")
    print(f"代码块    : {sum(len(m['chunks']) for m in b['modules'])}")

    cases = [("生存曲线", 5), ("circos", 5), ("单细胞", 5), ("volcano", 5)]
    print("\n检索自检:")
    for q, n in cases:
        r = json.loads(figureya_search(q, n))
        ids = [x["id"] for x in r.get("results", [])]
        print(f"  {q:10} -> {len(ids)} 条  {ids[:3]}")

    mid = b["modules"][0]["id"]
    print(f"\n取码自检: {mid}")
    code = json.loads(figureya_get_code(mid, chunk=0, include_deps=False))
    print(f"  chunk0 长度 {len(code['code_blocks'][0]['code'])} 字")
    mod = json.loads(figureya_get_module(mid, include_sections=False))
    print(f"  章节 {len(mod.get('chunks', []))} 个代码块, 依赖 {mod['packages']['all'][:3]}")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="FigureYa MCP server")
    ap.add_argument("--selftest", action="store_true", help="自检后退出")
    a = ap.parse_args()
    if a.selftest:
        sys.exit(selftest())
    mcp.run()

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# ============================================================
# FigureYa MCP 一键安装 / 注册（幂等，可重复跑）
#
# 做的事：
#   1. 检查 Python 与 mcp SDK，缺则安装
#   2. 若 reference/ 与 snapshot/bundle.json 都不存在，先拉源码再打包
#   3. 注册进 DSH web profile 与 Codex CLI
#   4. 自检：跑一次 tools/list + 检索
#
# 用法:
#   ./06_install_mcp.sh            # 安装 + 注册全部
#   ./06_install_mcp.sh --dsh      # 只注册 DSH
#   ./06_install_mcp.sh --codex    # 只注册 Codex
#   ./06_install_mcp.sh --check    # 只体检，不安装不写入
#   ./06_install_mcp.sh --bundle   # 只重建内容快照
# ============================================================
set -euo pipefail
cd "$(dirname "$0")"
HERE="$(pwd)"

PY="${FIGUREYA_PYTHON:-~/miniforge3/bin/python3}"
[ -x "$PY" ] || PY="$(command -v python3)"
SERVER="$HERE/05_mcp_server.py"
SNAPSHOT="$HERE/snapshot/bundle.json"
DSH_PATCH="$HOME/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml"
CODEX_CFG="$HOME/.codex/config.toml"

ONLY_DSH=0; ONLY_CODEX=0; CHECK=0; BUNDLE_ONLY=0
for a in "$@"; do
  case "$a" in
    --dsh) ONLY_DSH=1 ;;
    --codex) ONLY_CODEX=1 ;;
    --check) CHECK=1 ;;
    --bundle) BUNDLE_ONLY=1 ;;
    -h|--help) sed -n '2,20p' "$0"; exit 0 ;;
    *) echo "未知参数: $a"; exit 1 ;;
  esac
done

say() { printf '\n=== %s ===\n' "$1"; }

# ---------- 0. 体检 ----------
if [ "$CHECK" -eq 1 ]; then
  say "体检"
  echo "Python      : $PY ($("$PY" -V 2>&1))"
  if "$PY" -c "import mcp" 2>/dev/null; then
    echo "mcp SDK     : ✅ $("$PY" -c 'import importlib.metadata as m; print(m.version("mcp"))')"
  else
    echo "mcp SDK     : ❌ 未安装"
  fi
  [ -f "$SERVER" ] && echo "server 脚本 : ✅ $SERVER" || echo "server 脚本 : ❌ 缺失"
  [ -f "$SNAPSHOT" ] && echo "内容快照    : ✅ $(du -h "$SNAPSHOT" | cut -f1)" || echo "内容快照    : ❌ 缺失（跑 --bundle）"
  [ -d reference ] && echo "reference/  : ✅ $(du -sh reference | cut -f1)" || echo "reference/  : ⚠️  未拉取（跑 ../01_clone.sh）"
  grep -q "mcp-figureya" "$DSH_PATCH" 2>/dev/null && echo "DSH 注册    : ✅" || echo "DSH 注册    : ❌"
  grep -q "mcp_servers.figureya" "$CODEX_CFG" 2>/dev/null && echo "Codex 注册  : ✅" || echo "Codex 注册  : ❌"
  exit 0
fi

# ---------- 1. Python 依赖 ----------
say "1/4 检查 Python 与 mcp SDK"
if ! "$PY" -c "import mcp" 2>/dev/null; then
  echo "安装 mcp SDK..."
  "$PY" -m pip install -q "mcp[cli]"
fi
echo "Python: $PY ($("$PY" -V 2>&1))"
echo "mcp   : $("$PY" -c 'import importlib.metadata as m;print(m.version("mcp"))')"

# ---------- 2. 内容快照 ----------
say "2/4 内容快照"
if [ "$BUNDLE_ONLY" -eq 1 ] || [ ! -f "$SNAPSHOT" ]; then
  if [ ! -d reference ]; then
    echo "缺少 reference/，先拉源码："
    ./01_clone.sh
  fi
  "$PY" 04_build_bundle.py
else
  echo "已存在 $(du -h "$SNAPSHOT" | cut -f1)，跳过（--bundle 可强制重建）"
fi

# ---------- 3. 注册 ----------
register_dsh() {
  say "3/4 注册 DSH"
  if [ ! -f "$DSH_PATCH" ]; then
    echo "⚠️  找不到 $DSH_PATCH，跳过"
    return
  fi
  if grep -q "mcp-figureya" "$DSH_PATCH"; then
    echo "已存在 mcp-figureya，跳过"
    return
  fi
  cp -a "$DSH_PATCH" "$DSH_PATCH.bak-$(date +%Y%m%d%H%M%S)"
  "$PY" - "$DSH_PATCH" "$PY" "$SERVER" <<'PYEOF'
import sys, pathlib
patch, pybin, server = pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]), sys.argv[2], sys.argv[3]
s = patch.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
block = f"""
    - id: mcp-figureya
      name: "@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client"
      config:
        serverName: figureya
        transport: stdio
        command: {pybin}
        args: [ "{server}" ]
"""
anchor = "    - id: mcp-tavily\n"
if anchor not in s:
    sys.exit("未找到插入锚点 mcp-tavily，请手动添加")
patch.write_text(s.replace(anchor, block.lstrip("\n") + "\n" + anchor, 1), encoding="utf-8")
print("已插入 mcp-figureya")
PYEOF
  echo "✅ 写入 $DSH_PATCH（已备份）"
  echo "   验证: dsh --profile web --dump-config | grep -A7 mcp-figureya"
}

register_codex() {
  say "4/4 注册 Codex"
  if [ ! -f "$CODEX_CFG" ]; then
    echo "⚠️  找不到 $CODEX_CFG，跳过"
    return
  fi
  if grep -q "\[mcp_servers.figureya\]" "$CODEX_CFG"; then
    echo "已存在 [mcp_servers.figureya]，跳过"
    return
  fi
  cp -a "$CODEX_CFG" "$CODEX_CFG.bak-$(date +%Y%m%d%H%M%S)"
  cat >> "$CODEX_CFG" <<EOF

[mcp_servers.figureya]
command = "$PY"
args = ["$SERVER"]
EOF
  echo "✅ 追加到 $CODEX_CFG（已备份）"
}

[ "$ONLY_CODEX" -eq 0 ] && register_dsh
[ "$ONLY_DSH" -eq 0 ] && register_codex

# ---------- 5. 自检 ----------
say "自检"
"$PY" 05_mcp_server.py --selftest 2>&1 | tail -12

say "完成"
echo "Agent 内直接用: mcp__figureya__figureya_search 等 6 个工具"
echo "重跑本脚本安全（幂等），--check 看状态"

#!/usr/bin/env Rscript
# Auto-generated R dependency installation script
# This script installs all required R packages for this project

# Set up mirrors for better download performance
options("repos" = c(CRAN = "https://cloud.r-project.org/"))
# Note: BiocManager::install handles its own mirrors, so the BioC_mirror option is often not needed.

# Function to check if a package is installed
is_package_installed <- function(package_name) {
  return(package_name %in% rownames(installed.packages()))
}

# Function to install CRAN packages
install_cran_package <- function(package_name) {
  if (!is_package_installed(package_name)) {
    cat("Installing CRAN package:", package_name, "\n")
    tryCatch({
      install.packages(package_name, dependencies = TRUE)
      cat("Successfully installed:", package_name, "\n")
    }, error = function(e) {
      cat("Failed to install", package_name, ":", e$message, "\n")
    })
  } else {
    cat("Package already installed:", package_name, "\n")
  }
}

# Function to install Bioconductor packages
install_bioc_package <- function(package_name) {
  if (!is_package_installed(package_name)) {
    cat("Installing Bioconductor package:", package_name, "\n")
    tryCatch({
      if (!is_package_installed("BiocManager")) {
        install.packages("BiocManager")
      }
      # Also install Biobase as it's a key dependency
      BiocManager::install(c("Biobase", package_name), update = FALSE, ask = FALSE)
      cat("Successfully installed:", package_name, "\n")
    }, error = function(e) {
      cat("Failed to install", package_name, ":", e$message, "\n")
    })
  } else {
    cat("Package already installed:", package_name, "\n")
  }
}

cat("Starting R package installation...\n")
cat("===========================================\n")


# Installing CRAN packages
cat("\nInstalling CRAN packages...\n")
cran_packages <- c("stringr") # "ClassDiscovery" was removed from here

for (pkg in cran_packages) {
  install_cran_package(pkg)
}

# Installing Bioconductor packages
cat("\nInstalling Bioconductor packages...\n")
bioc_packages <- c("ClassDiscovery") # "ClassDiscovery" is now correctly listed here

for (pkg in bioc_packages) {
  install_bioc_package(pkg)
}


cat("\n===========================================\n")
cat("Package installation completed!\n")
cat("You can now run your R scripts in this directory.\n")
